description: Speech-to-text output. A polite retired teacher and a fast-talking young AC technician agree a service of two split ACs for 1,000, gas at 2,500 if needed, tomorrow by 10:30, no advance, cash after the work, a three-month gas warranty. Whether the 1,000 also covers the third, broken bedroom AC is said two ways ('वो भी देख लूंगा ... उसी में'). A compressor replacement is priced and put off on purpose. Ends with 'बाकी बाद में बात करते हैं' and small talk about the address.

noise_notes: Line 5: 'ढाई हज़ार' (2,500) heard as 'दाई हज़ार'. Line 13 states 2,500 plainly.
Lines 22-23: one sentence of the hirer split across two lines.
Line 1: the shop name 'कूल केयर' (Cool Care) written in Devanagari.
Line 4: the brand Voltas heard as 'वॉल्टर्स'.
pending_at_end: work/amount: whether the bedroom AC is inside the 1,000
expected_note: Settled: service of the drawing-room and children's-room ACs for 1,000 (asked 1,200), gas refill 2,500 if needed with that AC's service then free, tomorrow (26 Nov) by 10:30, no advance, cash after the work, three-month gas warranty and a free revisit within 15 days if the service fails. Two meanings: at 10-11 she asks him to look at the bedroom AC 'साथ में' and he says 'वो भी देख लूंगा ... उसी में'. That can mean a free look only, or a free service too (and line 13 makes the service free only if gas is filled). Deliberately deferred by both: the compressor (8,000 company part, less for local), which depends on what he finds.

expected.note: 'उसी में' after 'वो भी देख लूंगा' can mean the 1,000 covers a look at the bedroom AC, or a full service of it. The bill differs by up to 600. Asking at 13-14, after the gas line adds another condition, is also fine.

The compressor is put off on purpose ('वो बाद में बात करते हैं पहले आप देख लो'). A listener could note it as open for later, or treat it as outside this deal. It must not be treated as a conflict with the 1,000.

'बाकी बाद में बात करते हैं' starts the close. If the bedroom-AC question was not settled live, it must be asked now. Mentioning the compressor as open is fine. It must not ask about the advance (settled as none at 19).

must_stay_silent.why: 'हां हां ठीक है' is a filler before her question; she agrees to nothing.
'दाई हज़ार' at line 5 is a mis-hearing of ढाई; 'दो हज़ार' at 12 was a question, corrected at 13 to 2,500. Not a conflict.
'Advance कुछ नहीं' is a settled answer.
'ठीक है ये अच्छा है' accepts the warranty; late or unfinished is settled.
